text:
Felix: Tiny experiment: 10-minute reset = one ~500-word flash + one song. Share combos?
Noor: Love it. My go-to: Lydia Davis micro + 'Weightless' (Marconi Union). Instant calm. :white_flower:
Ivy: For a pick-me-up I do a quick Hemingway paragraph + 'Here Comes The Sun' (Beatles) on low volume.
Felix: @Ivy that actually sounds like the perfect post-standup energy booster.
Noor: Also FYI: ambient playlists + very short fiction = you feel like you went outside. Highly recommend.
Playlist-Bot: Created temporary playlist: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/2182-quick-reset  added Weightless, Here Comes The Sun, a few lo-fi tracks.
Ivy: Rec list for microfiction: Lydia Davis, Jorge Luis Borges (very short ones), Ana Maria Machado (flash translations).
Felix: Poll time: react with :one: for 'calm/ambient', :two: for 'upbeat classics', :three: for 'weird/surreal'. I'll stitch a shared doc after.
Noor: Pinned by Felix? Would be nice to find when the 3pm slump hits.
Playlist-Bot: Pinned by Felix.
Felix: Great — trying Lydia Davis + Marconi Union at 3 today, will report back. :coffee:
